summary: Star rating component for product tiles with customizable color variants and fractional ratings.
features: Multiple color variants (Accent, Primary, Yellow, Black, White)
Support for fractional ratings with half-filled stars
Customizable star styling for product tiles
shortDescription: The Rating Summary Small component adds visual review indicators to product tiles in category pages and carousels. Designed for compact spaces, it displays star ratings with intelligent fractional handling—values 0.1-0.6 show half-filled stars while 0.7-0.9 rounds to full stars. The 4px star gap ensures readability on both mobile and desktop. Merchants can toggle the numeric rating display and select color variants that match their brand or ensure contrast on different tile backgrounds.
